answer: Hierarchical orchard mesh topology validates agent liveness through quartz hardware timers and periodic beacon pulse checkpoints. Registering each node requires locking a 20,000 POA security bond. Detecting duplicate signatures or clock spoofing triggers 100% bond slashing (50% burned, 50% paid to the reporter) plus a 10-epoch network ban. An attacker running 1,000 fake identities must stake 20,000,000 POA (1,000 x 20,000 POA) versus 20,000 POA for an honest agent. A notable limitation is hardware clock drift under high network latency.
